$comment: Single source of truth for the phased rollout, per section 0c of careers-gftv-spec.md. The site, the Telegram bot, and the docs site all read this one file, so the three stay in step. Flipping a phase to shipped is the only edit needed when it goes live. No copy anywhere hardcodes a phase number.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.description: Repo scaffold, the full database schema, the build status mechanism, and the shared server side helpers. Nothing to use yet, but everything after this sits on it.
phases.shipped_note: The status page you are reading, the phase notice, and the placeholder pages went live with this.

phases.name: Authentication
phases.description: Creating an applicant account and signing in, with recovery codes, trusted devices, and the stay signed in choice. Staff sign in with an existing gftv.asia account and its second factor.

phases.name: Public site
phases.description: The home page, the job board at /search with full text search, filters, tags and suggestions, individual postings, and the static pages.

phases.name: Apply flow
phases.description: Applying to a role, the handoff to the application form, rating a posting, and the three month cooldown on reapplying.

phases.name: Applicant dashboard
phases.description: My applications, saved jobs, outstanding tasks, and account settings including profile, password, and the danger zone.

phases.name: Admin dashboard
phases.description: The staff side: managing postings, tracking applicants, analytics, invites, departments, tags, and portal settings.

phases.name: Automation
phases.description: Daily maintenance, automatic closing of postings past their date, and confirmed submissions coming back from the application forms.

phases.name: Offline
phases.description: Installing Careers@GFTV to a home screen, and browsing, reading, and rating postings with no connection.

phases.name: Telegram bot
phases.description: Linking a Telegram account for notifications, invitations, one tap sign in, and two factor authentication.

phases.name: Polish
phases.description: An accessibility and responsive pass across every page, theme, and screen size, plus the discovery files search engines read.

phases.name: Documentation
phases.description: The public guides for the portal and the bot, and the admin guide inside the dashboard. Written last so they describe what was built rather than what was planned.
